drafts.text:
A competitor's mailer just hit your area? Kind of good news.

It proves people here pay for what you do.

But a lot of folks who get that flyer google the service before they call anybody.

Make sure the site they land on is yours, and it loads fast.

stableafdesigns.com
drafts.best_time_ct: Weekday late morning CT; the standing 8:54 AM slot works for one a day.

drafts.type: AI Comprehension Tax on service pages
drafts.text:
Cyrus Shepard just named it the "AI Comprehension Tax": making readers wade through 3,000 AI words a human could say in 750.

On a local service page it's worse. Someone with a leak wants 4 things: what you fix, where, rough price, phone number.

Put them up top.
drafts.best_time_ct: Weekday late morning CT; the standing 8:54 AM slot works for one a day.

drafts.text:
"SEOs love Bing" -Lily Ray

Local owners should too. Microsoft Copilot runs on Bing.

If you set up your Google Business Profile and stopped there, take 10 minutes and claim Bing Places. It can import from Google.

Same name, address, phone everywhere.

drafts.text:
Halloween and holiday lights going up?

Plug outdoor decorations into GFCI-protected outlets, use outdoor-rated cords, and don't chain a bunch of strands together.

If that GFCI keeps tripping, don't tape it or bypass it. Call us.

SoLit Electric, Baton Rouge. 225-472-1165
drafts.video_tip: Video tip (@solitelectric, about 15 sec, phone vertical): Yancie at a real outdoor GFCI outlet. Press TEST, the outlet clicks off, a plugged-in light goes dark. Press RESET, light comes back. On-screen text: 'Test it once a month. Before the decorations go up.' End card: SoLit Electric, Baton Rouge, 225-472-1165. Real outlet, real footage, nothing staged.

drafts.text:
First cold snap is coming. Before the space heater comes out:

Plug it straight into the wall, not a power strip or extension cord.
Keep it 3 feet from beds, curtains, anything that burns.
If the plug or outlet gets hot, stop and call an electrician.

SoLit Electric. 225-472-1165

An outlet or switch that feels warm, buzzes, or smells like burning plastic is not a "later" problem.

Turn off that breaker and stop using it.

SoLit Electric is owned by licensed master electrician Yancie David. 24/7 emergency service in Baton Rouge.
225-472-1165
